notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.1.1 - The Last Expedition
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Samurai[/h1]

Welcome to 1.1.1 update brings additional QOL and bugfixes, but this will be the last patch for the entire game.

It’s been a privilege to work on Shadowveil, its been an absolute blast to take part of the Legend of the Five Rings universe, and the team eternally grateful to you, our community for supporting us in creating and launching Shadowveil.
 
Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five RIngs, and hopefully we see each other soon in another context. 
Take care and goodbye.

With love,
The team at Palindrome Interactive

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version number 1.1.1.19063[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a unique 3D model and portrait for Yasuki Nobitsugu
[*] Added a small VFX outline to map crab to differentiate it better
[*] Added QOL: Barricades now have HP and can be destroyed (5 hits), if enemies can’t reach your units they will target barricades
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127025/147b91e7c0ac966b3e13228a27da21f8785d222c.png[/img]
[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scouting parties button should now have a tooltip even when not unlocked
[*] ”Shifting Currents” healing breakdown should now correctly show a percentage instead of just a number
[*] Updated LLG sounds
[*] Updated percentage of nezumi favor gifting to show the correct percentages at all times.
[*] Updated enemy loadouts so enemies can now spawn in mixed compositions 
[*] Updated the speaking order of the Lost Library Guardians to better fit the cinematic the first time you encounter them
[*] Replaced reward in Ancient Practice side quest, as the experience gain was never supposed to be there.
[*] Additional Duty Slot upgrade icon is now the same size as all the other upgrades
[*] Ability “Battering Ram” changed to match text
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nezumi favors now get more expensive the more of them you get, and you can only get one per shop visit
[*] Chapter 9 shouldn't give extra Embark Slots
[/list]
[h3]Critical Fixes (Crashes/Softlock)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where loading a save with different items would lead to a crash
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed character bar at the bottom of the screen no longer overlaps quest UI
[*] Fixed run summary not showing correct stats
[*] Fixed issue in Ch10/endless where duty giving you extra temporary command points where permanent
[*] Fixed issue with Deploy All button thinking it actually deployed people when you clicked it during a paused battle
[*] Fixed “Had That, Built Those” challenge/achievement to take the new items into account
[*] Fixed traps no longer disappear after the first trigger if they are allowed to trigger multiple times
[*] Fixed Shadowveil nodes do not change when you retry combat anymore
[*] Fixed issue where paused function may fail to function when starting a battle with space key
[*] Fixed lighting saturation issue encountered act 2 and 3
[*] Fixed issue with mission “Stare into the abyss” that enabled you to complete it incorrectly
[*] Fixed Speed button highlight issues
[*] Fixed “Defeating the elite 2” challenge/achievement
[*] Fixed to be the stone petal effect spread implemented properly now
[*] Fixed run summary information not showing correctly
[*] Fixed left and right scroll in barracks 
[*] Fixed issues regarding recruiting ronin units that was missing names and masteries
[*] Fixed it is no longer possible to pause and unpause combat while the system menu is open
[*] Fixed a short freeze encountered when gifting 8 or more ability cards to the Nezumi at a merchant node
[*] Fixed crop issue in barracks with alternate berserker portrait
[*] Fixed Eternal items can no longer be activated if the equipped unit is not deployed
[*] Fixed so icon is hidden when hovering family tree name
[*] Fixed center screen icon in combat to flash the correct sign when pressing any of the speed control buttons
[*] Fixed ink trail doesn’t linger if axe throw drops target after windup
[*] Fixed sliding issue in tutorial
[*] Fixed path of sunlight widget looked like it was hovered by default
[*] Fixed issue where victory screen flickers upon pressing the Continue button in quick succession
[*] Fixed so Ith'ki should no longer mention taking your coin in Chapter 9, when everything was free of charge
[*] Removed extra space in combat log from enemy buffs and debuffs
[*] Various animation fixes
[*] Localization fixes
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
These are issues that we have seen but not been able to replicate nor have had the time to fix. As a result if you encounter them, reload the save, or load a backup.
[list]
[*] Rare crashes related to rendering, when placing units on boost tiles
[*] Rare crashes related to rendering, when encountering a boss
[*] Loading in run save games with "Hida Logistics" may give extra ability slots incorrectly, however starting a run should reset
[/list]

[h3]Discord[/h3]
Although development has ceased you can discuss the game in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url].

notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.1 - Closing a chapter
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Samurai[/h1]
My name is Filip and I’m the Game Director of Shadowveil.

Welcome to 1.1 our first major update which should make the game it's best, listen to the video where I also talk about some important news, so please watch the entire video.

[previewyoutube=7oMtnnuVcwo;full][/previewyoutube]
This patch should help the game feel more complete, give more build/experimentation opportunities and hopefully just feel better!

However with patch 1.1 also comes the closing of a chapter.
Patch 1.1 will be the last content patch for the game. We have one additional patch planned, 1.1.1 that brings additional QOL and bugfixes, but that will be the last patch for the entire game.

It’s been a privilege to work on Shadowveil, its been an absolute blast to take part of the Legend of the Five Rings universe, and the team and I are eternally grateful to you, our community for supporting us in creating and launching Shadowveil.
 
Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five RIngs, and hopefully we see each other soon in another context. 
Take care and goodbye.

With love,
Filip and the team at Palindrome Interactive

[h1]Patch Notes - 1.1[/h1]
[h2]Version number 1.1.0.18999[/h2]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 18 new ability cards (3 per class)
[*] Added 1 item component
[*] Added 9 item combinations
[*] Added Heroes of the Wall screen in magistrate to commemorate our speedrun winners (congratulations!).
[*] Added new 3D meshes to Lost Library Guardians
[*] Added 6 new alternate portraits to match the randomized meshes to increase differentiation.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127025/125b8746e71870986e5d7c67207328245194a6b8.png[/img]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] QOL: Added ability to skip event text
[*] QOL: Updated so UI should be visible on 16:10 aspect ratio screens (for example Steamdeck)
[*] “Spirit repulse” knockback is now 1 tile as stated
[*] Updated card breakdown on ability “Bloodthirst” and “Invigorating Heat”
[*] Card order in codex has been updated
[*] Changed so that objective marker shows on next step when advancing in missions
[*] Updated so the combat is considered as completed when Madoshi Necromancer dies, even if a summoned Spirit is still present
[*] Readded missing evasion section in codex
[*] You can now hover units in the character bar even when they are not deployed. The unit hover is also hidden when you have the inventory open.
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]
[h3]Embark Slots:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sibling level-up no longer rewards Embark slots.
[/list] This means Maximum Embark slots has been reduced to 7, down from 10.
[list]
[*] Hida Formation
Defense gained increased to 30 up from 10.
Unlocks in chapter 5, up from 1.
[*] Hida Logistics
Unlocks in chapter 1, down from 2.
[*] Reinforcements
Cost decreased to 2, down from 3.
Unlocks in chapter 2, down from 3.
[*] More Reinforcements
Unlocks in chapter 3, down from 4.
[*] Extra Reinforcements
Unlocks in chapter 4, down from 5.
[*] Critical Reinforcements
Cost increased to 4, up from 3.
[/list]
For save files with points invested in any of these Advancement you might see a shift in which Advancements are unlocked now. Worst case scenario you'll have to invest two Political Capital to re-learn one of them. This was the only way to restructure the tree without making a huge investment in rebuilding the save system, or invalidating save files. Sorry about the inconvenience.
[list]
[*] Slightly increased enemies HP and lowered their damage in later chapters to encourage more types of builds
[/list]

[h2]Critical Fixes (Crashes/Softlock)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Disabled Inventory during certain parts of tutorial to avoid softlocks
[*] Fixed a potential crash in the main menu
[*] Fixed crash related to achievement-file
[*] Fixed potential softlock when skipping intro
[*] Fixed a crash in the Shadowveil related to the event “Gamble in the Mist”
[*] Fixed a potential crash when going AFK
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with Nezumi slots on Chapter 10
[*] Fixed so Mission items should now be properly removed
[*] Fixed issues with using Escape to back out of menus
[*] Fixed issues with healthbar disappearing after cutscenes
[*] Fixed issues with subtitles on some missions
[*] Fixed issues with LLG “on defeat” effects
[*] Fixed issue where stacking items were not properly reset during LLG fight
[*] Fixed the returning to watchtower dialogue mentioning side quests should no longer trigger when you completed a side quest and came back to the watchtower
[*] Fixed issue where “Show Them Who’s Boss” and “Lost” Achievement/Challenge failed to be received
[*] Fixed issue with achievement “Into the unknown”
[*] Fixed issue where you couldn’t inspect bosses
[*] Fixed so amount of Bu some options costs in events is now visible
[*] Fixed issues with units in embark
[*] Fixed issues with quest textboxes overflowing
[*] Fixed issue so it is no longer possible to drag party units outside of the deployment phase
[*] Fixed potential issues with ability slot
[*] Fixed issue where decoys was in cinematics
[*] Fixed issue where scout parties where available before they were unlocked
[*] Fixed issue with speed controls
[*] Fixed issue where map markers would incorrectly show during rewards
[*] Fixed issue where you got extra fortitude when you shouldn’t
[*] Fixed issues where items that you didn't unlock could still be rewarded
[*] Fixed issue where world map VFX would play where it shouldn’t
[*] Fixed issues with order tutorial not disappearing
[*] Fixed issue where inventory could be accessed during loading screens
[*] Fixed name of Kuni Neyuki to actually be Kuni Neyuki in “Back from the Cliff” mission. She also animates when talking now.
[*] Fixed issue with scouting parties tooltip
[*] Fixed issue with Shadowveil entry nodes
[*] Fixed issue with Tactician materials being wrongly asigned
[*] Fixed issue where units could be invisible after cutscenes
[*] Fixed issue with subtitle not appearing when entering the Shadowveil as O-Ushi for the first time
[*] Fixed issue with tactician rally point
[*] Fixed issue with items not loading in fast enough to be displayed in the reward flow sometimes, which resulted in placeholder icons and texts being shown.
[*] Readded mention of Otter Clan
[*] Fixed issues with some dialogues
[*] Localization fixes
[/list]

[h3]How to report a bug?[/h3]
If you should encounter any issues, feel free to let us know. You can do so by submitting them in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/1280822521473536040/1347499487827988500]Bug-report Channel[/url] in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url].

Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings!

With love, 
The Palindrome Interactive team

notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.0.6 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h1]

We've just released Shadowveil Patch 1.0.6!

This patch includes a rework of the achievement system which should enable everyone to gain achievements correctly! 

[h1]Version number 1.0.6.18819[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added some missing quest item icons
[*] Added a icon for “entering sub-maps” node
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated how achievements are calculated and rewarded, this should fix achievements issues. If you have already unlocked an achievement it should now pop as soon as you start the game, or in the watchtower!
[*] QoL. Map improvements: Quest nodes are now different if they lead to a separate quest map or not; Shadowveil entry and exit nodes should now be way more clear and easy to understand. 
[*] Updated tooltips for several node types.
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] “Corrupted Spirit Champions” no longer has a dash and are slower
[*] ”Madōshi Necromancers” summon spirits more often.
[*] ”Lost Sentry” is now the only Lost that applies “Rot”. 
[*] Changed: Rot reduces healing 50%->80%
[/list]

[h2]Critical Fixes (Crashes/Softlock)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a potential crash related to rewards
[*] Fixed a potential crash related to fortitude
[*] Mission should no longer add objectives after they are completed that could lead to softlocks
[*] Fixed a potential crash in run summary
[*] Fixed a crash turning in missions
[*] Fixed loading issues related to worldmap that could cause a crash
[*] Fixed issues with map generation that could crash the game
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed various popup issues
[*] Fixed issue where bosses could appear in cutscenes
[*] Fixed The Oni should not start the Chapter 5 fight under the ground and player characters are more likely to be hidden during the cutscene
[*] Fixed Combat Summary UI background no longer flashes when opened
[*] Fixed issue where UI would disappear from the tutorial
[*] Fixed issue where UI would disappear when entering The Shadowveil
[*] Fixed issue with the Character bar
[*] Fixed issue where the wrong item was shown in event “The Broken Altar of Kuni Hatsuki”
[*] Fixed issue with backup save slots
[*] Fixed issues with VO dissapearing
[*] Various VFX tweaks
[/list]


[h3]How to report a bug?[/h3]
If you should encounter any issues, feel free to let us know. You can do so by submitting them in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/1280822521473536040/1347499487827988500]Bug-report Channel[/url] in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url].

Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings!

With love, 
The Palindrome Interactive team

notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.0.5 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h1]

1.0.5 just launched, and with it, a lot of improvements to the game!

[h1]Version number 1.0.5.18698[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added QoL: Retraining button. You can now retrain your characters so that you have more freedom in how you build your party. Retraining refunds all level-ups except character specific masteries and the class itself. Retraining costs one goblin skull per level above lvl 5.
[*] Added warning to restart the game when selecting certain graphics options
[*] Added 6 portraits for our hero characters
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127025/945d66c1df1a124eac2e371a890fb1403f304158.png[/img]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Further optimized textures
[*] Fixed lag spike when dragging first unit
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] QoL: Hovering nodes can now be inspected to show more information to the player
[*] Updated so the sibling will now be healed to 10 health if your party wipes but you win the combat
[*] Update the Hida Warbanner to show a new unique Hida Mon 
[*] Updated mission “Hidden Stashes” now only requires you to reach “The Cache” once.
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Critical heals are not as effective
[*] Political capital gain has been nerfed
[/list]

[h2]Critical Fixes (Crashes/Softlock)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed potential softlock in Chapter 6 during an event
[*] Fixed potential softlock when loading savefiles in our out of the Shadowveil that led to no available nodes
[*] Fixed a potential softlock in tutorial
[*] Fixed potential softlock when clicking escape rapidly
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Return to Watchtower confirmation text is now correct
[*] Fixed so Gate shouldn't allow player to Embark with more units than slots. 
[*] Fixed multiple stage quests are reset upon avoiding to claim the rewards in the designed order
[*] Fixed so the sibling can't be removed from party in chapter 9.
[*] Fixed the Oni Lord is no longer blocked from attacking units in melee range when standing in a smokescreen
[*] Fixed issue where completed status could show on non accessed missions
[*] Fixed “Battlefield Scavenging Method” should now actually give you items and abilities when you make camp... like it says it does.
[*] Fixed potential fix for world map brightness issue.
[*] Fixed character bar should no longer be visible after you click to move to a map node that takes you out of the map
[*] Fixed you should no longer be able to get the chapter specific ability “Binding Ritual” from the “What we left” behind event
[*] Fixed enemy ability Axe throw now always targets furthest unit
[*] Fixed issues with some tutorial popups lingering, not closing correctly or not opening at the correct spot
[*] Fixed issue with unit stats not updating correctly
[*] Fixed issue with missing subtitles in “Missing Scout” mission
[*] Removed O-Ushi as a speaker in the exit dialogue of Missing Scout, so she doesn't act like she's talking while the scout
[*] Fixed issue with summoned spirits being stationary
[*] Fixed  [spoiler]Possessed goblin[/spoiler] disappearing when encountering events and merchants
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Kikyo[/spoiler] stacks Defense rather than ATK
[*] Fixed issue where abilities could be swapped during the Pause upon having the Party view expanded option selected before starting the combat
[*] Fixed issue where duty rewards appeared blank
[*] Fixed several combat barks of the character O-Ushi are missing VO.
[*] Fixed issue with missing VO
[*] Fixed swapping items that cannot be equipped by the other unit no longer deletes the item
[*] Various audio tweaks
[*] Various animation tweaks
[*] Various technical widget tweaks
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bosses can appear in cutscenes
[*] Loading can sometimes show visual artifacts
[*] There is certain issues with bonus items when combining other items
[*] Loading backup saves in certain locations can lead to exploits
[/list]

[h3]How to report a bug?[/h3]
If you should encounter any issues, feel free to let us know. You can do so by submitting them in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/1280822521473536040/1347499487827988500]Bug-report Channel[/url] in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url].

Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings!

With love, 
The Palindrome Interactive team

notes.title: Shadowveil Patch 1.0.4 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h1]

We just launched version 1.0.4, and it includes a lot of updates and optimizations. See the full list below!

Shoutout to the player community in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url] for providing bug reports, so we can continue to track down and eliminate issues. You're true friends of the Crab Clan!

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] There is a softlock that can happen when entering the Shadowveil and exiting the game to main menu. When in the Shadowveil try to complete the entire path (so you are back on the main map) before exiting the game. This can also happen when using camp in the Shadowveil. For now try to use camp in the main map only. We are looking into hotfixing this next week!
[*] There is rare random crashes during battles which are hard to nail down, as above please report it on discord to help us solve them!
[*] Resolutions with 16:10 or other less common aspect ratios may have issues with the UI
[/list]


[h1]Version number 1.0.4.18507[/h1]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a missing event in earlier versions
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
The fifth patch brings the fifth optimization package. This time, further work has gone into VFX (details below) and a large rework of how UI is loaded to save RAM and VRAM.
[list]
[*] All VFX in the game has been tweaked to be more performant
[*] Fire effects are now more fiery!
[*] Optimized UI RAM usage.
[/list]

We've changed the rendering mode for many particles from "Translucent" to "Masked" due to how particle-heavy many fights can be later in the game.
Translucent particles cause heavy overdraw (re-rendering areas where they are) due to how rendering works in modern game engines - "Masked" materials, on the other hand, don't have this issue. 
To retain most of the transparency, we use something called "Dithering" (basically fading into dots), which does cause some graininess but is a good trade-off performance-wise.


[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] QoL: Updated descriptions and breakdowns for Berserker's Rage, Besiege, Burning Blossom Trap, Push Trap, Slash, and Earth Becomes Sky
[*] Event Ancient Temple now gives [spoiler]Kakeguchi's Bane at the end of the run[/spoiler]
[*] Changed what text is Header and Support Header in Fortitude Rewards
[*] Changed camera for card rewards depending on act
[*] Changed the skylight and the map FX to reduce rendering issues
[*] Changed so events stores all event options so that the “not selected” exclamation mark is correctly shown
[*] Changed hovering enemies and inspecting shows only relevant stats
[*] Changed so Corrupted Spirits show Evasion instead of Defense on hover
[*] Changed so markers/deployables can no longer be placed on top of each other
[/list]


[h2]Critical Fixes (Crashes/Softlock)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when that happened on the rare occasion of equipping two eternal items simultaneously. [spoiler]The one selected from embark and Kakeguchi's Bane[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed softlocking issue that disabled players control over moving units
[*] Fixed potential softlock in the tutorial
[*] Fixed a potential softlock in Chapter 6
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Enemy corpses now also become un-interactable when dead
[*] Fixed deck reward packs not showing correctly when there were more than 2 
[*] Fixed so Missions or special nodes now generate the same level content when you retry them
[*] Fixed so Revealing the entire map no longer shows encounters and paths from other acts 
[*] Fixed so that no combine arrow is shown if the item is on a dead unit (as it's locked)
[*] Fixed event hint tooltip showing the "You Receive" header when there are no direct rewards in “A Lost Crab Warrior” event
[*] Fixed issues where certain effects could damage untargetable units causing, issues.
[*] Fixed issue in chapter 5 where multiple bosses appeared present

[*] Fixed issues with Challenge “Training Dummy” and “Pessimist” 
[*] Fixed “The Last Disciple” mission to load the correct combat encounter

[*] Fixed node removal vfx played on already removed nodes
[*] Fixed the issue where Shadowveil map disappears after completing a node in the Shadowveil
[*] Fixed issue with Blessings tab overlapping duty selection while making camp, even though it was invisible
[*] Fixed mission “Waters of fury” not counting kills and resetting when returning to watchtower
[*] Fixed “Return to Watchtower” tutorial instruction should now disappear if you make camp while it's active
[*] Fixed issue with unit stat reward header not having the correct text formatting
[*] Fixed issue when loading the game from main menu didn’t stop music correctly
[*] Hidden rewards no longer force the "You Receive" header to be shown in event option tooltips
[*] Tweaked how we trigger the VFX for Boss 1 end combat scene to hopefully be more consistent 
[*] Minor tweaks to some boss fights
[*] Tweaked some animations in Watchtower
[*] Removed Otter Clan mentions in French
[*] Localization updates 
[/list]


[h3]How to report a bug?[/h3]
If you should encounter any issues, feel free to let us know. You can do so by submitting them in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/1280822521473536040/1347499487827988500]Bug-report Channel[/url] in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url].

With love, 
The Palindrome Interactive team

[h1]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h1]

1.0.3 just released, and another patch means another set of patch notes for Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings, so let's dive in. This patch includes some of the first of QoL changes that are highly requested by the community, more to come!
Special thanks to the players in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url] and the players on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url] for continuing to report and help track down issues. The Crab Clan appreciates your efforts!

[list]

notes.title: Post-Launch thoughts from the team.
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Soon the first week will have passed since the launch of Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings. The response has been amazing and seeing the community help each other out, strategize, think and execute their best expeditions in true Crab Clan spirit.

I cannot thank everyone enough, its been a true pleasure working on the game and the studio would love to continue supporting it.

On that note, I wanted to delve a bit deeper into what Palindrome have in store.

[h2]QoL and fixes[/h2]

Our main priority since launch has been to monitor the game and Discord to catch crashes and bugs. With your help, we’ve identified and resolved many issues and already pushed the 1.0.1 patch with multiple hotfixes.

[list]
[*] Recent Fixes & Improvements:
[*] Fixed multiple crashes and stability issues
[*] Various hotfixes based on community reports
[/list]

Full details of 1.0.1 can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2536960/announcements/detail/509574242369536157]here (1.0.1 Patch Notes)[/url] 


Beyond that the studio are monitoring feedback for QoL changes. Of course we have a multitude of things we want to tackle, but here are some of items that are on the top of our list

[h3]Upcoming QoL Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Respec System – Reset and adjust your character builds.
[*] Persistent Game Speed – Your preferred speed settings will carry between battles.
[*] Always-Accessible Inventory – View stats & items anytime.
[*] …and more based on your feedback!
[/list]

[h2]Steamdeck[/h2]

Right now, Shadowveil runs on Steam Deck but lacks controller support, making some UI elements difficult to navigate.

Palindrome are committed to getting Steam Deck Verified, but this requires:
[list]
[*] ✅ UI & UX optimizations for better readability
[*] ✅ Full controller support
[*] ✅ Further performance tuning
[/list]

For now, our top priority is stability and core fixes, but Steam Deck improvements will follow.

I want to be clear that this is a personal goal for me, so hang in tight, show us the support you can and the studio will work hard for it!

[h2]Content and DLC[/h2]

While the studio are still exploring larger content updates, here’s what we can confirm is coming soon:

[list]
[*] 🧙 Unique portraits for all hero characters
[*] 🗿    Updated models for the Lost Library Guardians
[*] 👀 More ways to increase the depth of your strategies!
[/list]

This is the most exciting avenue for Shadowveil but we are still in the early stages and can't promise much. Similar to the Steamdeck this is a larger undertaking that will take more time. I know how many of you want more cards, difficulty options or even a new Clan. But fret not I am in the same camp but it's to early to confirm anything. However make your voice heard, share the game, leave a review and if you have ideas please share them in the discord!

 

I hope this post shines some light on what Palindrome are working on and why. Again thank you for all support, the team and I are so happy about having such an amazing community. 
We’d love to hear your thoughts! Join us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Discussion[/url] or in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url] to share your feedback on future content.

If you’re enjoying Shadowveil, consider [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536960/Shadowveil_Legend_of_The_Five_Rings/]leaving a review[/url][/b], it helps us a lot!
Our wall still stands!



With love
Filip - Game Director

Launch Day is upon us, and we'd like to share the list of changes and fixes we've implemented for the full version of Shadowveil. The save system has changed between the demo and the full version, which means that demo saves will [b]no longer be playable in the full game[/b]. 

You can still enjoy the standalone demo for a bit longer, as it has been received very positively. However as our focus will transition to the full game, the demo will [b]NOT[/b] be updated for a while. There are known issues, performance issues and crashes with the demo that is fixed in the full game (again shoutout to the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Discord community[/url] and the players on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536960]Shadowveil Steam Forum[/url]), which we want to implement in the demo eventually!

This is the first optimization package for the game, while there is work still to be done, this will lower usage of RAM and VRAM significantly, improving performance but most importantly eliminating a majority of crashes reported during the demo.

[*] Enabled LODs for most objects in-game
[*] Optimized the most commonly used shaders to be more performant
[*] Optimized texture sizes for nonvirtual textures
[*] Optimized textures and shaders for streaming

notes.content:
[h1]Shadowveil - Steam Next Fest Update (21.02.2025)[/h1]

[h3]Greetings from Rokugan! [/h3]
The first update to Shadowveil is here, and we'd like to share the list of changes and fixes we've implemented since the demo went live. 

Before we start the list, we'd like to thank you for playing the demo and/or following the game's development. It has been super fun seeing the response from the community and we are working hard to alleviate the issues that has been reported.

We've included the known issues at the bottom of the list, that are [b]A:[/b] either not resolved yet ([b]in bold[/b]), or [i]B[/i] simply haven't made it into today's update ([i]in cursive[/i]). 

Feel free to let us know if you encounter any of the issues in category [b]A[/b]. You can do so by submitting them in the [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]Shadowveil Discord[/url]: [url=https://discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R]discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R[/url]

[h2]Patch notes for the Next Fest Update (21.02.2025)[/h2]
[h4]Version number: 0.1.17516[/h4]
Spoiler warning: Potential spoilers are listed with spoiler tags: [spoiler]like this[/spoiler]. 

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various optimization passes, specifically targeted at minimizing crashes related to RAM usage
(Note this is an ongoing process and we will continue with this for launch and beyond)
[/list]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added audio focus option, you can now have background audio enabled.
[*] Added save backup system to avoid total loss if save game is corrupted
[*] Added a button to dismiss non-unique units in barracks
[/list]

[h3]Updated[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated balance to match the player data we have gathered the last 2 weeks
[*] Updated subheader fonts

[*] Updated [spoiler]Madōshi Corruptors'[/spoiler] “mind control.” It now stuns instead of making units switch sides

[b]Update (24.02.2025): [/b]
[b]Corrupted Save File issue[/b]
[i]If your save file has become corrupted, you can always try to load the backup saves. These saves are from the same campaign but are created when you come back from a run/expedition. There are up to 5 back-up save files per campaign.

You can find your saves here: 
C:\Users\"UserName"\AppData\Local\Breach\Saved\SaveGames

In that folder, you will find your save slot (for example Slot_0.sav), and see that there are multiple back-up save files, that have “_backup” in their name (for example Slot_0_Backup_0.sav). 

To replace the save file;
[olist]
[*]Delete the normal Slot_X.sav file (For example Slot_0.sav)
[*]Copy the latest backup (for example Slot_0_Backup_0.sav) and paste it in the same folder. 
[*]Right click and rename the new file (for example Slot_0_Backup_0 - Copy.sav) to Slot_0.sav.
[*]In game, you can now load the older back up save from the normal save slot in the “Load Game” menu.
[/olist][/i]


Thank you for playing Shadowveil: Legend of the Five Rings

With love, 
The Palindrome Interactive team

notes.title: Working with the Legend of the Five Rings Franchise
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings from Rokugan![/h1]

[i]We sat down with Game Director Filip from Palindrome Interactive to get some thoughts on what it’s like working with the Legend of the Five Rings franchise. [/i]

[h3]Hello Filip! 
What’s it like working every day on the Legend of the Five Rings franchise? [/h3]
I think it's quite an honor and a very interesting task to work with Legend of the Five Rings. 
"The Franchise is brimming with lore from the AEG days, when the card game was revolutionary for letting fans decide the path of the story, and the Fantasy Flight Games era when that tradition continued through the LCG as well as the RPG." 
What we are working with is the new Clan Wars era, heavily inspired by the original Legend of the Five Rings storyline drawn from the tournaments and player choices. However, this will not be the exact same story from the AEG days, nor is it a direct continuation of the tale told alongside FFG’s LCG. 
A prime example of course is Shadowveil, taking beloved characters and setting them on an adventure that we hope will delight existing fans of the franchise but also serve as a vehicle for new people to discover and experience this great universe. As you might imagine, working with this is sometimes daunting, but I am confident and happy to work with Legend of the Five Rings each and every day. 

[h3]What aspects of the Legend of the Five Rings lore and world-building make it an interesting IP for a creative project like a video game? [/h3]
I think it's the sheer size of the universe. One could make basically any type of game set in Rokugan focusing on a specific clan or family. That's a very exciting prospect when starting a game project like Shadowveil. Some have asked us about the focus on the Crab Clan, asking whether we might be missing out on many of the other great things in the rest of Rokugan. I think it's a great question, but that is also the point of Shadowveil. It's a perfect stepping stone for new fans to get into the vast universe that Legend of the Five Rings presents. A regular good vs. evil setting is often used as a prologue to set the stakes, before politics is introduced and complex characters are put against each other. Often that leads to great interest in what comes next, and I think everyone here and fans want Legend of the Five Rings video games to continue after Shadowveil. 

[h3]How does the unique blend of fantasy and samurai culture in Legend of the Five Rings offer opportunities for innovative storytelling and game design? [/h3]
Well, I think the resurgence of roleplaying games shows that fantasy has a significant staying power. Legend of the Five Rings’s twist of course is that it's not only fantasy but also greatly inspired by feudal Japan and other Asian cultures. This creates an intricate world filled with mysteries and lore and, as I described above, it's so vast that you can go anywhere and find something new. This gives a fantastic toolbox to craft Shadowveil into a unique experience in not only its setting but also in its gameplay. Do we use existing abilities established in the card
game or TTRPG? Or do we try to figure out something new and cool that fits the video game? Those questions are what makes Legend of the Five Rings so fun to work with. 

[h3]What are some challenges working with the intricate political dynamics and clan relationships in Legend of the Five Rings? [/h3]
Again the sheer scale of it, and I think that's exactly why we wanted to focus on a couple of characters to be more approachable for both old and new fans. Being able to figure out a part of the world through the eyes of Hida Sukune or Hida O-Ushi helps us focus the lens on their relationship and their struggle to prove themselves to their father. I think this game will establish some of the groundwork for preparing the fans of the franchise for the storm that is approaching with the Clan Wars. 

[h3]What interesting considerations have you and the team done when crafting a digital Shadowlands-experience? [/h3]
I think in Shadowveil we have included multiple twists and turns to make this a fully unique experience. There has been thought put into each aspect of how we portray the Shadowlands in the best manner possible. This effort should be visible throughout the game, from the world map
that you use navigate from battle to battle, from the stepped animation style, where we aim to
create a disjointing feeling of corruption, to the increase in Shadowlands Taint as you travel deeper into the Shadowlands and the unique ways to use Cards to give your characters abilities and behaviors to face any of the minions of Fu Leng.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127025/0b36cf220c6f5f7c90ac393b9a3cad299486eaec.png[/img]

[h3]Can you reveal any characters, the fans might know from the Legend of the Five Rings franchise, that will appear in the game? [/h3]
We hinted at it on the Discord server ([url=https://discord.com/invite/ShadowveilL5R]discord.gg/ShadowveilL5R[/url]); the Kuni daimyō himself, Kuni Yori, will join Shadowveil. What he is up to, you will have to find out later! 

[h3]If the Crab Clan discovered a way to brew the perfect cup of tea, would they finally relax their vigil on the Kaiu Wall for a tea break? [/h3]
I think the most likely thing to happen here would be that the majority of families would scoff at the idea while the Yasuki family would sell the tea off to the rest of the empire, securing enough funds to continue to fight the Shadowlands. So basically a normal week for the Crab Clan, haha!

[i][b] Business as usual for the Crab Clan! In any case, thank you for your time, FIlip![/b][/i]

[i]Do you have any questions, you'd like to ask the development team? 
Let us know in a comment![/i]
